Abre a janela das análises, uma aba para: Opens the analyses window, one tab each: low edge, high edge, slope and piles (insert, analyze with colors, erase, quantify) and the quantities for Excel.
Abre a janela das tags: numerar fileiras: Opens the tags window: number rows and tables, and the row, table, module and string tags (insert and erase).
Abre no navegador um modelo 3D para gira: Opens a 3D model in the browser to orbit and zoom: terrain, tables in their type colors, piles and trees. Works offline.
Abre o painel de grupos: mesas, módulos,: Opens the groups panel: tables, modules, piles and kWp of each group.
Apaga e gera de novo a área com a config: Erases and regenerates the area with the current settings.
Apaga e gera de novo só a fileira da mes: Erases and regenerates only the row of the clicked table, with the tables in use; fixes the spacing after a swap.
Ativa o Clivus Solar neste PC com o códi: Activates Clivus Solar on this PC with the code generated in the app portal, and shows the license status.
Clica num ponto e responde X, Y e Z do t: Click a point to get the terrain X, Y and Z.
Confere o desenho: registros sumidos, pe: Checks the drawing: missing records, pending, duplicated and orphan tables, terrain stamp.
Devolve aos blocos copiados o nome do pa: Gives copied blocks back the plugin's standard name.
Escolhe o dia e o horário (ou um dia, um: Choose the day and time (or a day, a month, a whole year) and draw the objects' shadows on the terrain and tables, marking the modules they hit; over a period, the worst case.
Escolhe ou troca a superfície do desenho: Chooses or changes the drawing surface used as the terrain.
Escolhe à mão a altura da ponta baixa no: Sets by hand the low edge height at the first and last pile of the table.
Estruturas (mesas do desenho, vãos, ente: Structures (drawing tables, spans, embedment), table choice and colors, plant parameters and project styles.
Exporta as faces dos módulos escolhidos: Exports the faces of the chosen modules to PVsyst (DAE).
Exporta para o Excel o resumo, as quanti: Exports to Excel the summary, the analysis quantities and the piles.
Gera a área inteira com as mesas em uso,: Generates the whole area with the tables in use, without analysis (analyses are in the Analyses panel).
Idioma trocado: a ribbon já mudou; as ja: Language changed: the ribbon has already changed; windows change when opened again.
Lists the pending tables and why.
Marca a mesa escolhida como pendente, pa: Marks the chosen table as pending, to recalculate later.
O Clivus Solar: versão, onde fica o regi: Clivus Solar: version, where the diagnostic log is and what it does.
O idioma das janelas, da ribbon e das me: The language of Clivus Solar's windows, ribbon and messages. Applies to this user, in all drawings.
Objetos que fazem sombra nos módulos; o: Objects that cast shade on the modules; the first one is the tree.
Qual terreno está escolhido, a área, a c: Which terrain is chosen, the area, city, country and UTM SIRGAS 2000 zone; the location is also corrected there.
Recalcular, pontas à mão, validar, recon: Recalculate, manual ends, validate, recount and the other adjustments to tables already drawn.
Refaz a contagem de mesas, módulos, pila: Recounts tables, modules, piles and kWp from what is in the drawing.
Refaz a mesa escolhida no terreno de ond: Rebuilds the chosen table on the terrain where it is, with the same GUID.
Refaz só as mesas marcadas como pendente: Rebuilds only the tables marked as pending (moved, copied).
Refaz todas as áreas do desenho com a co: Regenerates all areas of the drawing with the current settings.
Traça a linha onde as fileiras nascem e: Draws the line where rows start and chooses their side.
Traça a área de implantação e a assenta: Draws the layout area and drapes it on the terrain.
Troca a mesa clicada por uma ou mais de: Swaps the clicked table for one or more of another type (for example, one 28 for two 14s), locking its start or end.
Árvore como um pirulito: tronco e copa c: A lollipop-shaped tree: cylindrical trunk and crown, each with height and width. Click where to place it; its base sits on the terrain and follows it when the tree is dragged.
